analysis.insight_summary: Users are searching for Microsoft Visio-compatible drawings for the [product_name] [article_no] relay. Official resources offer CAX and DXF formats but do not include native Visio files. Community members are creating and offering their own Visio files to fill this gap, highlighting a need for official resources compatible with widely used third-party software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate finding an official or easily available Microsoft Visio drawing for the [product_name] [article_no] relay, rather than needing to manually create such resources.
